_doc: Requests for tools/audio/stable_audio.py (WO-022): music, ambience and sound effects made locally by Stable Audio 3 Medium (text-to-audio), three prompts each from a different angle, `takes` per prompt, auditioned on .audio/audition.html. `pick` trims, fades and normalises a take into assets/audio/<section>/<name>.wav (looping ones get their seam crossfaded). The palette (WO-022): noir jazz at the base, a double bass, a brushed kit and a smoky horn, and each world adds its colour; the Pier its organ, the suburbs their easy listening. Never name an artist, a band or another game in a prompt.

defaults.negative_prompt: music, melody, speech, words, singing, voice, long reverb tail, background noise, hum

music.title: Music
music.about: Loops for each place and moment, under everything. Noir jazz at the base; each world adds its colour.

defaults.negative_prompt: vocals, singing, speech, lyrics, rap, sound effects, crowd noise, applause, distortion, lo-fi hiss

ambience.title: Ambience
ambience.about: Beds that sit under the music in each place (looped, quiet).

defaults.negative_prompt: music, melody, instruments, speech, words, singing

sfx.title: Sound effects
sfx.about: One-shots, grouped by what makes them.
